# Quantum Fidelity Coherence

This repository studies root fidelity F = abs(<psi|phi>) between two fixed unknown pure states supplied as independent copies.

Its sister is Quantum Holonomy Sampling: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Holonomy-Sampling. The relation is a proved transfer of the complete-reset fixed-source transcript method to a four-state loop phase. The phase theorem needs a separate block-information calculation; the two-state root-fidelity tradeoff cannot be reused by parameter substitution.

Essential distinctions:
- b is the total number of source copies consumed between complete quantum resets, not simultaneous memory width.
- Only classical input-dependent information crosses a reset; every accessible future quantum register must be input-independent conditional on the complete history.
- Source requests are classical labels. No coherent preparation oracle or inverse is supplied.
- The root-fidelity error is uniform, including nearly orthogonal inputs.
- The matching rate is high-dimensional; the finite-dimension gap is stated explicitly.
- The common-Haar pure-stock comparison applies to any fixed finite set of pure sources. Its reset and polynomial assumptions must be retained.
- Scalar Schur-label sufficiency is specific to the two-source block. Four-source stocks can retain matrix-valued multiplicity information.
- The sparse-cycle phase theorem fixes small angular accuracy while overlap amplitude c tends to zero. It establishes the copy-optimal run endpoint, not a matched full phase tradeoff.
- At fixed finite dimension, separate-copy tomography can evade either high-dimensional run penalty. Neither theorem is dimension-unqualified.

- Exact theorem, constants, source model, and dimension domain: science/model.md.

- General pure-stock Haar/Gaussian norms, Bombieri product inequality, and measurable adaptive transcript comparison: science/haar_comparison.md.
- Fixed-source lower bound, adaptive allocation, stopping, and necessary coherent-run size: science/adaptive_converse.md.
- Sister transfer, four-source padding, phase-specific block input, large-dimension endpoint, and fixed-dimension counterexample: science/loop_phase.md; learning/bridge.md Section 7.
- Authoritative phase block-information and coherent-run proofs: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Holonomy-Sampling/blob/36297ca5f51fbfa361f5cd5184e901fb66b3b46e/science/block-information.md and https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Holonomy-Sampling/blob/36297ca5f51fbfa361f5cd5184e901fb66b3b46e/science/coherent-runs.md.
- Physical and statistical meaning, squared-overlap distinction, and pure-qubit counterexample to dimension-free sharpness: science/interpretation.md.
- Attribution and comparison limits: references/related_work.md; references/sources.bib.
- Finite verification and reproduction: verification/README.md.

The collective measurement and grouped implementation are inherited from Fanizza et al.; unrestricted sample optimality is known from Wang–Zhang. Replica hierarchies and one-sided adaptive likelihood precedents are credited to Ye–Liu–Deng. Bargmann invariants and cycle tests are credited to Oszmaniec–Brod–Galvão. Normalized polynomial estimation and constant circuit-depth trace estimation have different guarantees from phase accuracy and consumed copies per complete reset; consult references/related_work.md before comparing their rates.

This repository owns the root-fidelity coherent-run law and the reusable fixed-source comparison. Quantum Holonomy Sampling owns the loop-phase construction, phase-specific information theorem, and phase converse. The local science/loop_phase.md supplies the definitions and proof route needed to understand the exchange without replacing either account by unexplained links. Finite numerical checks are not universal proofs or independent expert certification.

Use the learning map for conceptual dependencies and the topic pages in science/ for authoritative claims and full proofs. The anchor supplies foundations; the exact block kernel and fixed-source adaptive reduction require the separate project derivations and research-level ingredients identified in the bridge. The map describes shared understanding targets, without learner-specific assessment or progress records.
